ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator: fall 2024 admissions summary and enrollment, student-to-faculty ratio

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, fall 2025 first-year class. Totals match the sum of the residency table (in-state 14,218 + out-of-state 326 + international 403 applicants; 13,472 + 288 + 335 admits; 2,138 + 13 + 11 enrolled). International applicants were admitted at about 83% versus about 94% overall. College Navigator shows fall 2024: 14,543 applicants, 94% admitted. SAT/ACT are not used in admission, so the score ranges below describe only the 15% of enrollees (317 students) who voluntarily sent an SAT score (ACT: 13 students, too few to report). Under admission factors, the Common Data Set marks standardized test scores 'very important', and its test policy answer appears to mark SAT/ACT as recommended, which conflicts with the CSU-wide test-blind policy that College Navigator reports; the test scores factor is therefore not shown. Undergraduate enrollment is 15,948 (the Common Data Set total); international undergraduates number 182 (degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates).

cost.notes: The Common Data Set reports no aid from the college itself awarded to degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates (0 recipients). The Common Data Set tuition figures are not used; costs come from CSUSB's international tuition-and-fees page
